title: game/data/fieldMoves.json: field moves that open a run's side areas (roguelite track RL-R2; logic/run-side.js)

type.description: the type a Billie needs to use it, and whose badge (meta.badges, by the type's id in lower case) opens it: a types.json name

obstacle.description: what stands in the way on the main path (logic/mapgen.js MAPGEN_FIELD_OBSTACLES)

biome.description: the side area's biome: a biomes.json biome (RL-R2b: it may be one a region never draws, such as the cave)

land.description: RL-R2b: the map generator's land dials for the side area's places, over the run's (logic/mapgen.js MAPGEN_DEFAULTS.land: Surf's coast water, the cave's rock walls)

townLand.description: RL-R2b: the land dials of the side area's town, over `land` (Surf's islet: water islet)

ride.description: true: its places are ridden (water walkable, you sit on the Water Billie: walk/prop-look.js rideMountItem)

areas.description: the side area's names, one picked by the run's seed

look.description: the obstacle, before any badge of its type is kept

needBadge.description: the obstacle without the badge ({badge}: the badge's name)

needType.description: the obstacle with the badge but no Billie of the type in the team

ask.description: the obstacle when it can be opened (a yes opens it)

used.description: as it opens ({billie}: the Billie's name)

travel.description: RL-R2b: the words on the dark as the way out takes you back (game/js/field-moves.js fieldWayOutTravel)

out.description: the side area's way out, back to the main path
